# [CS080] Use strings.ReplaceAll (go.style.strings-replace-all)

strings.Replace is called with n = -1.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | INFO |
| **Category** | Style |
| **CWE** | - |
| **OWASP** | - |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | Yes |

## Why It Matters in Go

strings.ReplaceAll states the intent directly; a -1 count is easy to misread or to change by accident. The fix rewrites the call.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
out := strings.Replace(name, " ", "_", -1)
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
out := strings.ReplaceAll(name, " ", "_")
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [go.style.strings-replace-all]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    go.style.strings-replace-all: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore go.style.strings-replace-all -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** go.style.strings-replace-all
```
